verdict.rationale: dlt has an official, documented command-line interface that creates, adds, inspects and deploys pipelines. The dltHub CLI adds `dlthub deploy` and monitoring of pipeline health and logs, and getting started can launch a coding agent directly. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and documentation of agent-oriented CLI features such as machine-readable output.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Creates, adds, inspects and deploys dlt pipelines.
Deploy your pipelines with a single `dlthub deploy` command.
Use the dltHub CLI and the Web UI at app.dlthub.com to monitor pipeline health, inspect logs, and diagnose failures.
runs a sample pipeline in your personal Playground workspace, and launches your coding agent ready to build your own source
